country.evidence_quote: The term “No Antibiotics Ever” is used on labels for poultry products when the producer does not administer antibiotics at any stage of the turkey’s life and maintains documentation supporting the claim in accordance with USDA-FSIS (United States Department of Agriculture Food Safety and Inspection Service) labeling requirements. If a turkey receives antibiotics for the treatment or prevention of illness, it cannot be labeled as “Raised Without Antibiotics” or “No Antibiotics Ever.” Additionally
